//: The INLINE shape — `pnpm --filter backend dev`, one process serving traffic AND running jobs. `pnpm dev` does not use this file: it starts dev:web and dev:cron, which have their own configs (nodemon.web.json / nodemon.cron.json) watching their own sentinels so that a change only one of them cares about restarts only that one. An inline process has both roles, so it still restarts on everything.
//2: src is deliberately NOT watched here — the whole tree is hot-reloaded in-process by src/utils/dev/hot-reload.ts, which purges the edited module's dependent closure when that is safe and touches this role's sentinel when it is not. nodemon only watches what genuinely cannot be swapped: the entry points, the Sequelize models, .env, and that sentinel. types/ is not watched either: it holds nothing but type declarations, which ts-node --transpile-only erases, so a change there cannot affect the running process. If boot itself fails the reloader never starts, so src/utils/dev/boot-guard.ts takes over the sentinel.
